title: Second Copy
summary: Start: enter Second Copy. The log opens the job and the helm marks the Print Factor. Do: come within 320 meters of the Print Factor. The factor slides alongside and reads which copy is yours. An ambush holds the bad copies until you enter 520 meters. Finish: after the factor is met, come inside Print Yard's shell. The Charter writes standing. Fail: there is no timer. Leave and the job stays open until you close. The shell alone does not file it.
